muslim:2452.note: Aisha: the wives and the longest hands; Zaynab bint Jahsh worked with her hands and gave in charity; no tanning or sewing, no creaking floor

muslim:3005.grader: Sahih Muslim (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
muslim:3005.note: Suhayb: the king, the sorcerer, the monk and the boy; the mountain shakes and the boat capsizes; it does not say Surah al-Buruj was revealed about it

tirmidhi:3892.note: Safiyyah taunted by other wives; 'Harun is my father, Musa my uncle, Muhammad my husband'; weak per Darussalam so held lightly
